title: Role of Multidetector Computerized Tomography (MDCT) in Diagnosis of Non Traumatic Acute Abdomen in Pediatric Age Group.
brief_summary: To evaluate the role of MDCT in diagnosis of non traumatic causes of acute abdomen in pediatric patients with clinical and surgical correlation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients presented by acute abdominal pain from first day of life till fifteen years old.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients above 15 years old.
* Patients with traumatic cause of acute abdominal pain.
study_population: The role of MDCT in diagnosis of non traumatic causes of acute abdomen in pediatric patients with clinical and surgical correlation.
